en: Black‑and‑white image showing a woman in a long dress standing on an ornate, decorative footbridge over a small pond in a lush, landscaped garden. The bridge has elaborate wrought‑iron railings with floral scrollwork and a gentle arch of brick or stone. Surrounding the scene are dense trees, shrubs, and water plants, giving a romantic park or estate‑garden atmosphere. There is no visible printed caption or border text on the image side.
